NON_REVERSIBLE_WRITE_BLOCKED.mechanism: Write operations without source-declared cleanup/compensation are blocked by the compensation gate

BINDING_GRAPH_BLOCKED.mechanism: After write, no source-declared GET readback surface exists to bind runtime state observation

OBSERVER_COMPILE_NOT_GROUNDED.mechanism: Observer compiler cannot map assertions to a concrete readback surface

TRANSPORT_FAILED.mechanism: Target policy blocks execution_mode for certain obligation types
TRANSPORT_FAILED.affected_operations: Obligations requiring write execution mode not approved by policy

COMPENSATION_AUTHORITY_NOT_PROVEN.mechanism: Cleanup contract drift: declared cleanup no longer matches compiled experiment

OPERATION_BINDING_NOT_RESOLVED.mechanism: Behavior IR operation not found for obligation

BUDGET_NOT_SELECTED.mechanism: Obligation not included in the execution plan (deferred by prioritizer)
